schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE EMP (NAME INT, DEPT INT, EMP INT);
CREATE TABLE DEPT (DEPT INT, LOC INT, MGR INT);
q1: SELECT X.NAME AS XN FROM EMP AS X WHERE (X.EMP, X.DEPT) IN (SELECT Y.MGR, Y.DEPT FROM DEPT AS Y WHERE Y.LOC = 3)
q2: SELECT X.NAME AS XN FROM EMP AS X
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT X.NAME AS XN FROM EMP AS X WHERE (X.EMP, X.DEPT) IN (SELECT Y.MGR, Y.DEPT FROM DEPT AS Y WHERE Y.LOC = 3)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT X.NAME AS XN FROM EMP AS X
explanation: Q1 filters employees who are managers of departments in location 3, while Q2 returns all employees. They are not equivalent when there are employees not managing such departments.
counterexample_dsp: A department in location 3 with manager 100, and another employee 200 in the same department but not a manager.
